name: Waterline Masjid
summary: A mosque with one slender minaret and a broad rounded dome rests above a single unhurried water curve.
why: A single contour joins the rounded dome to its hall and right minaret, all meeting the y=63 foundation. The dome and doorway share x=51. More than five units of visible clear space separate the building from the wave, whose endpoints match the architectural width.
risk: The water cue introduces a sense of calm and cleansing, but also makes the mark feel more place-based than a pure prayer-time symbol.
reasonToChoose: You want prayer and calm water to share one balanced identity.
